Requiring door_open before the box adds no spurious constraint since the box room has no other entrance, so the accepted language equals the task language under the natural reading that 'be holding the key on at least two different moves' means the condition holds at >=2 steps; a pickup-drop-repickup pattern is also handled (the re-pickup step fires u1->u2). Reachability: all states are reachable and the standard solution (pickup, hold >=2 steps, toggle open, drop key, pickup box) drives u0->u1->u2->u3->uF with no traps: u1 waits through a drop via else until re-pickup, u2 waits for the door, and u3 correctly does not regress when the door is toggled shut, since the task does not require the door open at pickup and the unlocked door can be reopened without the key. Ordered coverage: every state has an else self-loop covering irrelevant events, including the unused event key_lost; the overlap at u1 between 'has_door_key & door_open' and 'has_door_key' is resolved deterministically by listing the conjunction first, and both resolutions preserve the path-invariant total (0.1+0.3 vs 0.1+0.1+0.2, either way +1.0 = 1.4). Persistent/event distinctions respected: edges exploit persistence of has_door_key and door_open (u2->u3 fires on any step the door is open, not just the opening step), target_picked_up is last-step-only and aligns with terminal uF, and key_lost (an event) is rightly unused since the task never references it. Rewards: positive monotone milestones, bounded at 1.4, each progress edge fires at most once so there is no farming loop; the holding counters are monotone so no explicit regression edges are required. Format: exact headers, nonempty FINAL_STATES with uF declared in STATES and accepting for the task. Minor note only: (u1, has_door_key) could be narrowed to 'has_door_key & not door_open' to make u1's outgoing labels formally disjoint, but with ordered first-match evaluation the artifact as written is well-defined and behaviorally identical.
